sources.entry: PawMambo - Creates short AI dog dance videos from a dog photo and a dance-reference video. #freemium #video #pets

summary.name: PawMambo
summary.one_liner: PawMambo is a web studio that generates short AI dance videos of a dog by combining a dog photo with a dance reference video.
keywords: ai video from photo and video
use_cases: Make a dance video of your dog for a social media post
Create a birthday or pet account clip from a dog photo
Send a dancing dog video to a friend
Try dance moves from sample or uploaded reference clips on a dog photo
summary.what_it_does:
PawMambo takes one JPG or PNG photo of a dog (up to 8 MB) and a dance reference video, either a built-in sample or the user's own 3 to 30 second clip. The reference video guides the motion, and the dog photo is used for the dog's face, coat, and markings. It outputs 720p video. Users sign in to generate, can copy a share page link, download a copy, and see submitted jobs in their profile. The page says it is focused on dogs and that cat results are untested.</①_what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">freemium
notable: Uses a reference dance video to guide motion while the dog photo sets appearance
Accepts your own 3 to 30 second reference clip or built-in dance videos
New accounts get 20 free credits for a 10-second video; failed generations cost 0 credits
caveats: Movement and timing fidelity to the reference clip has not been fully tested, per the page
Cat results are untested; focused on dogs
Output is 720p and sign-in is required to generate
